title: Remove invented empirical observations and enforce honest probe/metric semantics (P01)
acceptance_criteria: Explicitly identified real execution adapter required for measured results
Preserve unavailable metrics as unavailable with reason and provenance
Validate finite values, required dimensions, and sample counts without false defaults
Derived cost computed only from adequately observed inputs
Tests use isolated destination and never append to historical journals
description: Remove invented empirical observations, ensure missing adapter returns non-measured, and isolate probe tests from historical journals (P01).
